QUOTE: `run_async_ask` worker | `ExternalBridge::run_async_ask` (`external_bridge.cpp:1158`) | Per `entropic.ask`, **detached**; "`run_async_ask` ends with `}).detach();`... Nothing tracks it. `stop()` does not wait for in-flight async workers... I found no in-flight counter or join."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as the detached thread (the others are joined) and says it has no join, so it can outlive the bridge and handle.
